newsitem.title: UK: Reward offered after surfing dog is stolen.
newsitem.headline: Reward offered after surfing dog is stolen.

text.p: A reward has been offered for the return of Max, the surfing dog, after he was stolen from outside a British supermarket while his owner was buying him a steak, newspapers reported on Saturday.
Pete Bounds, a former captain of the British surfing team, spent the Christmas holiday searching in vain for the four-year-old mongrel.

He has put up posters around the Welsh town of Haverfordwest and offered a 100 pound ($170) reward in an attempt to recover Max, who has made several television appearances with his specially designed surf board and wetsuit.
"I am absolutely shattered," Bounds said. "I am convinced that someone has stolen him as a present for a child." ($1=.5943 Pound)
